title: Game-Ware
overview:
Game-Ware is the first issue of a magazine on CD-ROM for the Sega Saturn, packed with small games, videos, interviews and advertisements.

- Series of Dreams: a Playing Movie Game told in installments
- Pipitboy no Daibouken: a comedy 3D puzzle game
- Edison Tantei Jimusho: an arcade-style game
- Telecom Town and HG Cup: advertisements turned into playable games
- Information corner covering music and more
- A playable demo of Digital Pinball: Last Gladiators
